name: Ozi Image Alt Tag Fixer — Smart Image SEO & Alt Text Optimizer
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.faq:
Will the plugin overwrite existing alt text?

No. Existing alt tags remain untouched unless the Override Existing ALT Tags option is enabled.

Does it rename images or change URLs?

No. The plugin only modifies the alt attribute of images.

Does this work with page builders like Divi or Elementor?

Yes. The plugin works with all major builders and themes.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

sections.description:
Automatically detect, generate, and fix missing image alt text across your website. Improve accessibility, image SEO, and search visibility with a lightweight WordPress plugin. —

Overview

Many websites contain hundreds of images with missing or poor alt text.
This harms both SEO and accessibility.

Search engines rely on alt text to understand images.
Screen readers rely on alt text for visually impaired users.

Ozi Image Alt Tag Fixer automatically scans your website, detects missing alt tags, and generates optimized alt text using intelligent rules.

The plugin provides a simple dashboard that shows:

• Image SEO score
• Missing alt tags
• Duplicate alt tags
• Optimization suggestions

You can then fix everything instantly with a single click.

Key Features

Image SEO Scanner

Analyze your website’s images and instantly see:

• Total images detected
• Missing alt tags
• Duplicate alt text
• Keyword optimized alt tags
• Overall Image SEO Score

Smart Alt Text Generator

Automatically generate descriptive alt text using multiple strategies:

  1. Simple Mode — Keyword + filename
  2. Smart Mode — Intelligent keyword matching
  3. Page-Aware Mode — Uses page titles for context
  4. Hybrid Mode — Combines multiple signals for better results

Bulk Fix Missing Alt Tags

Fix missing alt text across your entire Media Library with one click.

No manual editing required.

ALT Suggestion Preview

Before applying fixes, the dashboard shows a preview table:

• Current ALT text
• Image status (Good / Missing / Generic)
• Suggested ALT improvements

Duplicate ALT Detection

Identify duplicate alt text across images to improve search clarity and accessibility.

Works With Page Builders

Compatible with all major builders and themes:

• Divi
• Elementor
• Gutenberg
• Bricks
• WooCommerce
• Any WordPress theme

Lightweight & Fast

No external APIs
No third-party tracking
No heavy scripts

The plugin runs entirely inside WordPress.

Accessibility Friendly

Improves accessibility for screen readers and helps meet WCAG accessibility standards.

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Go to Ozi Alt Tag Fixer → Dashboard
  3. Click Scan Images
  4. Review the analysis
  5. Click Bulk Fix ALT Tags

All missing alt tags are generated instantly.

Optional: adjust generation logic in the Settings page.

Use Cases

Perfect for:

• Bloggers with large image libraries
• WooCommerce stores
• SEO professionals
• Agencies managing client sites
• Website owners improving accessibility

Upgrade Path: OziDigital PRO

Unlock additional SEO tools:

• Advanced content analysis
• Meta automation
• Schema markup generation
• Keyword insights
• AI-assisted optimization
• Full on-page SEO toolkit

Credits

Created by Ozinexus Technologies (Australia)

Focused on engineering-driven SEO tools and website performance solutions.
